## Entity 2: NestJS Validation Pipe & DTO Validation

- **ID**: `skill-validation-pipe`
- **Slug**: `validation-pipe`
- **Type**: `skill`
- **Category**: Backend Security & Clean Code
- **Difficulty**: Intermediate
- **Tags**: `nestjs`, `validation`, `dto`, `class-validator`
- **Reading Time**: 8 mins
- **Created**: 2026-02-01T00:00:00.000Z
- **Updated**: 2026-07-15T00:00:00.000Z

### Summary
Learn how to automatically parse and sanitize incoming HTTP request bodies via Data Transfer Objects.

### Description
Enforcing runtime payload validation using NestJS built-in ValidationPipe and class-validator decorators (`@IsString()`, `@IsNumber()`, `@IsOptional()`, `@ValidateNested()`). Ensures payload integrity before controller action execution.

### External Resources
- Official Docs: https://docs.nestjs.com/techniques/validation

### Graph Relationships
- **Related Topics**: `topic-nestjs` (`nestjs`)

## Entity 3: Global Exception Filters & Error Handling

- **ID**: `skill-exception-filter`
- **Slug**: `exception-filter`
- **Type**: `skill`
- **Category**: Backend Resilience
- **Difficulty**: Advanced
- **Tags**: `nestjs`, `error-handling`, `filters`, `resilience`
- **Reading Time**: 10 mins
- **Created**: 2026-02-10T00:00:00.000Z
- **Updated**: 2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z

### Summary
Implement robust centralized error logging, error response formatting, and security masking in NestJS.

### Description
Catching and standardizing unhandled application exceptions across all HTTP and RPC entrypoints using custom `@Catch()` filters. Prevents sensitive stacktrace leaks in production while maintaining audit logs.

### External Resources
- Official Docs: https://docs.nestjs.com/exception-filters
